title: Born in Greenville, Mississippi; father leads the Grand Opera House orchestra
summary: Hirsch was born in Greenville; his father led the orchestra at the Grand Opera House, which hosted vaudeville, road shows and minstrel shows.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Oh, I forgot to ask you where you were born.
I was born in Greenville, Mississippi, the Queen City of the Delta, Washington County, Mississippi.

my father was a band, an orchestra leader. He was the orchestra leader at the Grand Opera House, which was a theater in Greenville, and he was the orchestra leader. And they used to have all kind of shows coming through there in those days. It was not an opera. Exactly as an opera, like La Tosca, or the great operas. It was, they had attractions of vaudeville, shows, road shows, and also minstrel shows, and things like that. What they used to refer to as burlesque opera, huh? Yeah. Yeah.
